title: AID Test Portfolio Audit — Project Config
$comment: producer: PM (hand-edited) or /aid-init copy-if-absent, consumers: [aid-test-audit-config.sh load_test_audit_config, aid-test-audit-dispatch.sh, aid-test-audit-command-allowlist.sh]
description: Project-level audit config contract (.aid-o/config/test-audit.yaml). budget_minutes_default/max_read_only_audit_agents/allowed_runners are read by THIS (P066) plan. resource_locks/scheduler were reserved for P069 (depends_on_plans:[P066]) so it wouldn't need a second schema revision — P066 itself never reads or writes them. P069 has since shipped (v2.67.0) and reads scheduler.* for real.

max_read_only_audit_agents.description: Wholly distinct from dispatch.max_parallel (defaults/orchestration.yaml) and dispatch.worktrees.max_parallel (.aid-o/config/policies/dispatch-strategy.yaml) — neither existing key is read or written by this schema/loader.

resource_locks.description: Unused by P066's own logic — reserved for P069, which has since shipped (v2.67.0).

scheduler.description: Unused by P066's own logic — present only so P069 wouldn't need a second schema revision. P069 has since shipped (v2.67.0) and reads scheduler.* for real via aid-run-gates.sh's rollout-gated dispatch.
